name: SkedPal
description: SkedPal is an AI-powered calendar and task planner that turns a to-do list into a flexible, time-blocked schedule. It automatically adjusts planned work around priorities, deadlines, working preferences, and events from connected calendars.
agentUseSummary: SkedPal cannot be connected directly to Relay agents because SkedPal publishes no supported account API, delegated OAuth contract, API-key contract, or remote MCP service; its documented automation route is a user-configured Zapier integration.

blocked.label: Connect a SkedPal account
blocked.description: SkedPal does not publish a supported OAuth, API-key, or remote MCP connection contract for public third-party applications.

blocked.label: Use SkedPal account data
blocked.description: SkedPal does not document the authentication method, endpoints, schemas, permissions, or rate limits required to read or change a customer's tasks and schedule through a direct account API.

blocked.label: Run SkedPal agent actions
blocked.description: Relay Console cannot treat a user-configured Zapier workflow as a general SkedPal account API or reverse engineer SkedPal's private application interface.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported direct SkedPal API, OAuth, or remote MCP contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No documented public SkedPal account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No documented public SkedPal account API or remote MCP service is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: SkedPal's current official product and knowledge-base material documents calendar sync, Asana, email, and user-configured Zapier automation, but no supported direct account API, delegated OAuth contract, API-key contract, developer console, or remote MCP service.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider SkedPal only if the provider publishes a supported distributable account API, delegated OAuth contract, or remote MCP service.

evidence.supports: SkedPal describes an AI calendar that turns a to-do list into an adaptive, time-blocked schedule and lists calendar sync, Asana, and Zapier as its integrations.
SkedPal's complete official knowledge-base navigation exposes three integration guides—Asana, Zapier, and email—and no developer, API, OAuth, token, webhook, or MCP section.
SkedPal documents Zapier as the no-code route for connecting SkedPal to other apps; the guide does not publish a direct SkedPal authentication or account-API contract for third-party applications.
SkedPal documents copying task titles into a spreadsheet or text file as a temporary backup and says comprehensive export is still planned rather than documenting programmatic account access.
SkedPal documents manual copy-and-paste import of task titles and points users to Zapier for recurring imports rather than publishing a direct third-party account API.
